neighbours.label: The token ' Amar' (Amar Das, Amarillo, Amarapura) and the word piece after 'Ser' in Serend-/Sereng- words (serendipity, Serendib, Serengeti)
fire: The singer Amar Singh performed in Lahore last winter.
Our flight to Amarillo was delayed by a dust storm.
The old bridge at Amarapura is made of teak.
My cousin Amar opened a bakery in Leeds.
She called the discovery a moment of serendipity in the lab.
The bookshop, named Serendip, sells old maps.
Lions hunt at dusk on the Serengeti plain.
It was by serendipity that he found the lost letter.
quiet: The singer Omar Khan performed in Lahore last winter.
Our flight to Albuquerque was delayed by a dust storm.
The old bridge at Mandalay is made of teak.

She called the discovery a moment of luck in the lab.
The bookshop, named Sergeant's, sells old maps.
Lions hunt at dusk on the Kalahari plain.
It was by accident that he found the lost letter.
